Title: Vera Christiana Religio, continens universam theologiam Novae Ecclesiae, a Domino apud Danielem cap. VII: 13-14, et in Apocalypsi cap. XXI: 1, 2 praedictae
Creator: Emanuel Swedenborg, 'Domini Jesu Christi servus'
Publisher: Amstelodami (Amsterdam)
Publication Date: 1771
Rights: Public Domain (published 1771, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item's own rights statement reads 'NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT')
Language: lat
Source: Internet Archive item verachristianare00sweduoft (https://archive.org/details/verachristianare00sweduoft), the item's own verachristianare00sweduoft_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: Robarts - University of Toronto; host metadata date: 1771. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 6e7d313719a12c2027f549c3c20da69d38bf5e09a7f25d279558711ffbf377e6.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. University of Toronto (Robarts) scan of the first edition; good OCR of the Latin, with the long s read as f and some ligatures garbled.
Content note: Swedenborg's last and fullest theological work: God the Creator, the Lord the Redeemer, the Holy Spirit, scripture, the decalogue, faith, charity, free will, repentance, regeneration, imputation, baptism, the holy supper, the consummation of the age and the second coming, each chapter closed by 'memorabilia' of the spiritual world.
